local_library_scan.title: Local Library Scan
local_library_scan.description: Scan external local directories and import supported images (.jpg, .jpeg, .png, .webp, .gif). Files are copied into storage; originals are never moved or deleted.
local_library_scan.scan_path_hint: Leave empty to use paths from .env LOCAL_LIBRARY_PATHS
local_library_scan.max_files_hint: Limit the number of candidate files to process
local_library_scan.hydrated_only_hint: Skip cloud-only files (iCloud, OneDrive). Prevents triggering mass downloads.
local_library_scan.preflight_hint: Stat-only scan — never opens files, safe for cloud directories.
local_library_scan.icloud_safety_note: iCloud Safety: Files with cloud-only attributes are skipped when Hydrated Only is enabled. Preflight never opens files.

ai_tagging.title: AI Auto Tagging
ai_tagging.batch_description: Tag multiple images at once. If no Media IDs are specified, selects images without existing AI tags.
ai_tagging.batch_limit_note: Note: Batch size is capped by AI_TAGGING_BATCH_MAX_ITEMS (default 10), configurable in .env.

tag_localization.title: Tag Localization
tag_localization.batch_description: Use the configured LLM service to batch translate uncovered tags.
tag_localization.llm_not_configured: LLM translation not configured. Set TAG_TRANSLATION_LLM_* in .env.
tag_localization.worker_description: Background auto-translation continuously processes untranslated tags in batches. To control costs and API rate limits, each cycle processes a portion — seeing missing tags temporarily is normal. The system will eventually translate all tags.
tag_localization.worker_cost_warning: Real LLM translation incurs API costs. Use daily limit and max per run to control spending.
tag_localization.batch_manual_note: Manual batch translation is for debugging or immediate fixes. Normally the background auto-translation will handle all missing tags automatically.
tag_localization.entity_description: Character, copyright, and artist tags need established Chinese names — not translations. The entity resolver finds well-known aliases (e.g., hatsune_miku → 初音未来). Unknown names are kept as-is and flagged for review.
tag_localization.entity_cost_warning: Entity resolution uses LLM API calls. Use max per run to control costs.
tag_localization.entity_result: Resolution complete: {resolved} resolved, {kept} kept original, {failed} failed
